tools.name: app.describe_actions
tools.title: Describe reviewed actions
tools.description: Search reviewed actions with query/limit/cursor, or use outcome alone for the complete request contract. Limit is a maximum; byte-bounded pages may contain fewer entries. Follow next_cursor until null. Search returns bounded summaries; an empty call retains a bounded compatibility page of full contracts. Browse or search a shortlist, inspect the chosen outcome, then request it. Availability is not eligibility. No source rows are read and no authority is granted.

inputSchema.description: Use outcome alone for exact detail, or query/limit/cursor for listing.

tools.name: app.request_change
tools.title: Request a reviewed change
tools.description: Request one activated business outcome using opaque Explore references and only the typed business inputs described by app.describe_actions. Runner validates those inputs and reloads authoritative facts to derive an immutable proposal; this tool cannot approve, apply, or accept an arbitrary patch. To check an accepted request later, repeat the identical outcome, original subject_refs and inputs. An already recorded request returns its durable status, not a second proposal. Do not obtain new references to check status. Completion requires a verified execution receipt; if authority or context changed, report unavailable rather than recreating the request.

tools.name: app.describe_data
tools.title: Describe reviewed data
tools.description: Metadata only; no source rows. Search reviewed resources with query, limit and the opaque returned cursor. Limit is a maximum; byte-bounded pages may contain fewer entries. Follow next_cursor until null. Empty input returns a bounded shortlist. Use resource with optional boundary, without search/pagination arguments, for a complete focused contract. Copy exact ids into app.explore_data for values. Search matches are not row eligibility.

boundary.description: Exact active boundary name; empty means omitted.

resource.description: Exact resource id; empty means omitted.

tools.name: app.explore_data
tools.title: Explore reviewed data
tools.description: Runs one reviewed read-only local plan. Call app.describe_data first and copy exact ids. Send {boundary?,plan:{...}}; plan.kind is exactly rows or aggregate. Aggregate: {"plan":{"kind":"aggregate","resource":"<exact resource id>","measures":[{"function":"count"}],"dimensions":[{"field":"<field>"}]}}. For totals or averages, use sum or avg with one exact reviewed measure field. Omitted top_n uses Runner's reviewed bound. Related grouping: {"dimensions":[{"field":"<exact target field>","relationship":"<exact reviewed relationship id>"}]}. When the question asks base records by a related field, use that pair instead of a similar local field; never concatenate the ids. Rows: {"plan":{"kind":"rows","resource":"<exact resource id>","select":["<field>"]}}. Omitted limit uses Runner's reviewed bound. Related row details use "related":[{"relationship":"<exact reviewed relationship id>","select":["<exact target field>"]}]. At most three paths and twenty total fields; each path preserves the reviewed customer scope. Returned keys are <relationship>.<field>. Named controls use {"derived_measure":"<name>"} in measures or {"numeric_band":"<name>"} in dimensions. Filter example: "where":[{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"completed"}]. Use exactly where + op, never filter(s) + operator. Values must be concrete, not null; use null_count, non_null_count, or completion_rate for missing-data analysis. Ranked aggregate example: "order_by":{"kind":"measure","index":0,"direction":"desc"},"top_n":25. Aggregate order_by is one object and uses top_n, never limit. One reviewed relative window uses {"time_window":{"field":"<reviewed time field>","window":"previous_month"}}. Complete two-period plan: {"plan":{"kind":"aggregate","resource":"<exact resource id>","measures":[{"function":"count"}],"dimensions":[{"field":"<group field>"}],"time_bucket":{"field":"<time field>","bucket":"month"},"comparison":{"field":"<time field>","window":"this_month","compare_to":"preceding_period"}}}. time_bucket and comparison are sibling plan keys, never nested. Runner resolves names once in authority-bound UTC. Never calculate dates or invent offsets. No cross-boundary joins, SQL, model-selected tenant/principal, mutation, approval, or commit.

boundary.description: Exact active boundary name; empty means omitted.

plan.description: Copy one complete plan from app.describe_data or this tool description. Optional reviewed controls include time_window, order_by kind "comparison_change". Dimension-by-time returns one row per dimension/time combination. Runner strictly validates every nested key before execution.
